title: Senolytic Therapy to Modulate the Progression of Alzheimer's Disease (SToMP-AD) Study

sections.abstract: The objective of the study is to determine the safety, feasibility, and efficacy of senolytics in older adults with amnestic mild cognitive impairment (MCI) or early-stage AD (Clinical Dementia Rating (CDR)=0.5 or 1) who are tau PET positive
